name: Notebook
description: Markdown notes in a folder you choose, with links between them.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the person's notes in Notebook (their markdown vault) by words. Returns the best-matching notes with their path, title and the passage that matched. Use it for anything they may have written down.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. 'sourdough starter'.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read one note from the person's Notebook in full, by its path (from search or list) or its title.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List the notes in the person's Notebook (or in one folder of it), newest first, with their paths and titles.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Write a new note in the person's Notebook. `title` is just its name; everything it should say goes in `text` (for 'a note called Groceries with milk and eggs': title 'Groceries', text '- milk\n- eggs'). It's saved straight away, in their own notes (nothing leaves the computer).

title.description: Only the note's name, which is also its file name: for 'a note called Groceries with milk and eggs' the title is 'Groceries'.

text.description: The note's markdown text: what goes in it (for that example, the milk and eggs).

folder.description: A folder in the vault (default: the top).

tools.name: append
tools.description: Add text to the end of an existing note in the person's Notebook, by its path or title.

text.description: Markdown to add at the end.
